Caring for your flowers

Water

Change the water every day or two and use a clean vase.

Stems

Cut a couple of centimetres at an angle before putting them in water.

Light

Soft light is best, without hours of direct sun.

Heat

Keep away from radiators, heaters and ripe fruit bowls.

Questions

How do I place an order?

Message us on WhatsApp with the occasion, size and date. We confirm flowers and price.

How far ahead should I order?

The sooner the better, especially on special dates. For a simple bouquet, a day or two is usually enough.

Will the flowers match the picture?

The illustrated bouquet and the calendar are examples. We use what is in season and confirm it when you order.

I have pets, what should I do?

Tell us when you order. Some flowers and plants can be toxic and we will avoid the most delicate ones. If in doubt, ask a vet.

I have a pollen allergy

We can prepare a bouquet with few pollen flowers. We cannot promise it is hypoallergenic.

How long do the flowers last?

It depends on the flower, the heat and the care. We give you tips for looking after them at home.
